arStrings.szText:
{c_important}Initiate Lair Bosses{/c} have a chance to appear instead of Helltide Commanders after Helltide Events.

Killing {c_important}Lair Bosses{/c} in Helltides while earning the {c_important}Event Mastery{/c} grants many random {c_important}Lair Boss{/c} materials.

This only occurs in {c_important}Torment+{/c} difficulties.
